about: Canonical ids for Bay County, Florida governments. Every published dataset row carries gov_id from this list. A CRA is a dependent district governed by its city commission, so CRA names resolve to the city's id (the CRA ledger keeps its own cra column). Aliases are matched exactly after lowercasing, trimming, dropping a trailing parenthetical or ' - ...' note, and collapsing spaces; a string that matches nothing gets no gov_id rather than a guess.
fiscal_years: Bay County, the cities, constitutional officers, CRAs and special districts use a fiscal year of October 1 to September 30 (FY2024 = 2023-10-01 to 2024-09-30). Bay District Schools uses July 1 to June 30 (2025-26 = 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30).
